bifrost: springboard/src/media/hwdec/ (libavcodec + VA-API decode), springboard/src/media/convert.rs (NV12 to RGBA), springboard/src/gpu/nv12.rs (NV12 dma-buf import), springboard/src/shell/video.rs (consumer)
summary: BifrOSt decodes H.264 and HEVC in hardware (VA-API through libavcodec, software fallback) and converts NV12 to RGBA for the shell, but only inside the media stack. No app-facing SDK API exists, and there is no compression session, encoder, pixel transfer, rotation, RAW, HDR metadata or frame processing.
